Surgical Strike.name: Surgical Strike
Surgical Strike.summary: Surgical Strike is an on-rails action shooter game that takes place against a full motion video backdrop depicting chaotic, war-ravaged cityscapes. You are to pilot the hovercraft, fire either bullets or rockets at opportune moments, and issue turn directives at key junctures. Miss a cue and another precious military hovercraft will be toast and you'll be chewed out by your superior officer and peers alike.

Urusei Yatsura - Dear My Friends.name: Urusei Yatsura: Dear My Friends
Urusei Yatsura - Dear My Friends.summary: This adventure game was released only in Japan and is based on Rumiko Takashi's Urusei Yatsura series.
